scope: The principal Orthodox Church of the Holy Spirit in the Vilnius monastery, with the 2007 west front, twin turrets, domed crossing and eastern apses.

references.filename: Orthodox Church of the Holy Spirit in Vilnius2.JPG

originalReview.notes: The exact photo shows the cream and pale-yellow west front, rust-colored tower cap, dark wooden main door, shallow porch pediment and cream pilasters.

quallaSearch.notes: Alma Pater’s exact August 2007 photograph was published by Qualla and released to the public domain by the photographer. The other published photo candidates depict different subjects.
